name: Abyssal
rawEffects: Gain 20% more luck during the night. Darkness increases 50% slower.
location: In the Abyssal Depths Maze, just after crossing the obby, head left, then right.

name: Annihilation I
rawEffects: Automatically destroy Common and Uncommon ores when panning.
location: In the tunnel from Deeproot Spring to Enchanted Ruins .

name: Annihilation II
rawEffects: Automatically destroy Rare and Epic ores when panning.
location: Located at the far back right of Fungal Marsh , surrounded by red crystals.

name: Annihilation III
rawEffects: Automatically destroy Legendary ores when panning.
location: Located behind a tree at Starfall River , surrounded by red crystals.

name: Bunny
rawEffects: Gain +5% modifier boost for every +1 bonus jump power.
location: Found on a cliff in Starfall River near the Meteor Golem NPC.

name: Critical I
rawEffects: Digging has a 20% chance to have 2x strength.
location: Inside the Merchant hut in Sunset Beach .

name: Critical II
rawEffects: Digging has a 20% chance to have 2x strength.
location: Inside one of the huts near the Ranger on Caldera Park .

name: Discovery
rawEffects: Chance of obtaining undiscovered ores is increased by 50%.
location: Inside the Maze under the Windswept Beach Lighthouse, just at the entrance past the podium/pedestal.

name: Eternity
rawEffects: Your totem timers decrease 20% slower.
location: Found in the Timelocked Sanctuary .

name: Equalizer
rawEffects: Your dig speed and shake speed are equalized to their average.
location: Inside the hut behind Old Prospector in Fortune River Delta .

name: Explorer
rawEffects: When collecting geodes, gain a 20% chance to collect another geode.
location: On top of the Stone Mountain in Fortune River Delta .

name: Mountain Climber
rawEffects: Gain 3 walkspeed.
location: Find the Freezing Prospector at Frostbitten Path and go towards where he's looking. You'll find the rune down below.

name: Purity
rawEffects: +1x Luck multiplier, BUT MODIFIERS CAN NO LONGER BE OBTAINED.
location: Received upon completing the Botanist quest. (Rejoining might be required.)

name: Seeker's Mark
rawEffects: Items needed for your active quests are 10% easier to obtain.
location: At the top of the pyramid in the Sunscorched Desert .

name: Singularity I
rawEffects: Status effect timers tick 10% slower. Does not apply if your status timer speed is already 0.5x lower before runes.
location: Found on top of the big meteor at Excavation Site E in Fungal Marsh .

name: Singularity II
rawEffects: Status effect timers tick 10% slower. Does not apply if your status timer speed is already 0.5x lower before runes.
location: Found at the back of The Void (opposite side from the entrance).

name: Solitude
rawEffects: +20% Luck, but lose 10% Luck for every other player within 50 studs.
location: Below the rocks near the Lighthouse in Windswept Beach .

name: Speed I
rawEffects: Gain 2 walkspeed.
location: In Rubble Creek , behind the rock (behind the statue).

name: Summit Seeker
rawEffects: Gain 5% dig and shake speed for every +1 bonus walkspeed.
location: In front of the entrance in Frozen Peak .

name: Sunblessed
rawEffects: Gain 20% more luck in the sunlight.
location: Inside the area behind the waterfall/locked door in Crystal Caverns .

name: Veteran
rawEffects: Gain 25% more luck in regions you've fully mastered.
location: Next to the right-hand Sphinx guarding the Lifespring Oasis .

name: Volcanic
rawEffects: Ores with the scorched modifier gain 25% size.
location: On top of the Volcano. (You need to spam jump, or complete the Flame Priest quest, as lava deals damage)
